tr.title: Past Simple nedir? (geçmiş zaman)
tr.metaDesc: Past Simple nedir? Geçmiş zaman: V2 / -ed. Kullanımı, present perfect ile farkı — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: Past Simple (geçmiş zaman), geçmişte belirli bir zamanda bitmiş olaylar için kullanılır. Düzenli fiiller -ed alır, düzensizler 2. hâle (V2) geçer.

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

means.def: Present Perfect farkı: belirli geçmiş zaman
means.t: Onu dün gördüm. (belirli zaman → past simple)

en.title: What is the Past Simple?
en.metaDesc: What is the Past Simple? Past tense: V2 / -ed. Use, and vs present perfect — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: The Past Simple is used for actions finished at a specific time in the past. Regular verbs add -ed; irregular verbs use their past form (V2).

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

means.def: vs Present Perfect: a specific past time

de.title: Was ist das Past Simple?
de.metaDesc: Was ist das Past Simple? Vergangenheit: V2 / -ed. Nutzung, vs Present Perfect — LinguaBattle.
de.lede: Das Past Simple wird für Handlungen verwendet, die zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit abgeschlossen wurden. Regelmäßige Verben: -ed; unregelmäßige: Vergangenheitsform (V2).

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

fr.title: Qu'est-ce que le Past Simple ?
fr.metaDesc: Qu'est-ce que le Past Simple ? Passé : V2 / -ed. Usage, vs present perfect — LinguaBattle.
fr.lede: Le Past Simple s'emploie pour des actions terminées à un moment précis du passé. Verbes réguliers : -ed ; irréguliers : forme du passé (V2).

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

means.def: vs Present Perfect : passé daté précis

es.title: ¿Qué es el Past Simple?
es.metaDesc: ¿Qué es el Past Simple? Pasado: V2 / -ed. Uso, vs present perfect — LinguaBattle.
es.lede: El Past Simple se usa para acciones terminadas en un momento concreto del pasado. Verbos regulares: -ed; irregulares: forma de pasado (V2).

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

ar.title: ما هو Past Simple؟
ar.metaDesc: ما هو Past Simple؟ الماضي البسيط: V2 / -ed. الاستخدام، مقابل present perfect — LinguaBattle.
ar.lede: Past Simple يُستخدم للأحداث المنتهية في وقت محدّد في الماضي. الأفعال المنتظمة: -ed؛ الشاذة: صيغة الماضي (V2).

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

means.def: مقابل Present Perfect: زمن ماضٍ محدّد

hi.title: Past Simple क्या है?
hi.metaDesc: Past Simple क्या है? भूतकाल: V2 / -ed। प्रयोग, present perfect से अंतर — LinguaBattle.
hi.lede: Past Simple भूत में किसी निश्चित समय पर पूरे हुए कामों के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है। नियमित क्रियाएँ -ed लेती हैं; अनियमित दूसरा रूप (V2)।

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

means.def: Present Perfect से अंतर: निश्चित बीता समय

ru.title: Что такое Past Simple?
ru.metaDesc: Что такое Past Simple? Простое прошедшее: V2 / -ed. Использование, vs present perfect — LinguaBattle.
ru.lede: Past Simple используется для действий, завершённых в конкретный момент прошлого. Правильные глаголы: -ed; неправильные: форма прошедшего (V2).

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

pt.title: O que é o Past Simple?
pt.metaDesc: O que é o Past Simple? Passado simples: V2 / -ed. Uso, vs present perfect — LinguaBattle.
pt.lede: O Past Simple é usado para ações terminadas num momento específico do passado. Verbos regulares: -ed; irregulares: forma do passado (V2).

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

ja.title: Past Simpleとは？
ja.metaDesc: Past Simpleとは？過去形：V2 / -ed。使い方、present perfectとの違い — LinguaBattle.
ja.lede: Past Simple（過去形）は、過去の特定の時点で終わった動作に使う。規則動詞は-ed、不規則動詞は過去形（V2）。

means.en: Did you see it? I didn't.

means.def: Present Perfectとの違い：明確な過去の時
